title: process-research-now drops registration_note; Reference.metadata stays null
description:
## Observed (TI-c46828 E2E)

`assignments process-research-now` registered 18 pending references from a research packet catalog.

Catalog items include `metadata.registration_note` (ingestion rationale text). Live `Reference` rows for those ids have `metadata: null` and no other rationale field.

## Expected

Ingestion rationale from proposedReferences / catalog metadata is preserved on the pending Reference so triage and operators can see why it was proposed without opening the research packet.

## Evidence

- Assignment: `assignment-research-e2e-ingestion-exercise-ai-agent-tool-use-security-advisories-and-html-primary-so-20260726T193857938451Z`
- Catalog under `.papyrus-runs/research-proposals-*/research-proposals-catalog.json`
- Sample ref: `reference-knowledge-corpus-threat-intelligence-research-proposal-5e968ae0d3bbadbf-v1`

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
## Before you change anything: the observation is right, the diagnosis is probably wrong

`Reference.metadata` being null is **by design**, not a bug. `model_attachments.py:327` does:

```python
elif record["modelName"] == "Reference" and "metadata" in expected:
    metadata = parse_jsonish(expected.pop("metadata"))
```

It **pops** the field off the record and writes it to a `ModelAttachment` with `role="metadata"`, because DynamoDB items have a size limit and large payloads are offloaded to S3. Every accepted reference in this corpus works that way. So "Reference.metadata stays null" is the system behaving correctly.

**The real question is whether `registration_note` reaches that attachment.** Check that first, because it decides which layer is broken:

- **If the note is in the `role="metadata"` attachment**: the write path is fine and the bug is in whatever read `Reference.metadata` directly and found nothing — likely the queue builder. Fix the reader. Do not touch the intake path.
- **If the note is absent from the attachment too**: the bug is upstream in `catalog.py`. `item_registration_note` is computed at `:286-289` and feeds `curation_note`, but confirm it actually lands in `normalized_metadata` (`:299`) rather than only being used for the curation note.

Concretely: pick one of the 18 new prospects, fetch its `ModelAttachment` rows, find `role="metadata"`, and read the content. That single check tells you which fix to make.

## Why this matters beyond the bug

The rationale is what makes a review queue reviewable. Without it a prospect is a URL and a title, and the operator has to reconstruct context the machine already had. It is also the input to `kanbus-ec5555` (grounding triage rationales) — the 30-item session found 0/30 rationales sufficient to decide from without opening the source, and missing provenance is part of why.

Together with `TI-1ad2f4`, this is why the ingestion exercise had to write an `operator-queue.json` sidecar: the schema currently cannot answer "what is in my review queue and why is each item here." That sidecar is a symptom. Fix these two and the queue derives from the data model.
